name: Trap Master
source_text: FLIP: Destroys 1 Trap Card on the field. If this card's target is face-down, flip it face-up. If the card is a Trap Card, it is destroyed. If not, it is returned to its face-down position. The flipped card is not activated.
notes: The engine knows the printed type, so only a Trap is selectable.
